title: BRIDGEWOOD - Kim Possible (feat. Ben Sex)
htmlContent:
BRIDGEWOOD has dropped a new single called "Kim Possible", featuring Ben Sex. The focus and dedication runs rampant in the song with the production setting the tone, for the ambitious approach to the writing and melodic approach that makes music for the soul to keep going, while being entertained limitlessly.

 BRIDGEWOOD's "Kim Possible" feat. Ben Sex is a commanding record, with a sound that can not to be stopped. It’s a music experience that makes you want to dive into their whole catalog, and become invested in these sure stars with a must hear sound the world will love.
